description:
Find coins that match rules — the same screener engine as asrai.me/coins (~4,700 coins, signals read on closed candles). Three ways:
1. READY SCREENS (`ready`): Asrai's ready-made screens, each marked with Asrai's backtest (a fixed stop & target plan on years of daily history vs random coins: ✅ small edge / no edge / ⚠️ worse). Call with no arguments to list them with their marks. Keys: fresh-asrix, trend-buy, oversold, above-ema200, support-discount, smc-turned-up, five-up-done, small-active, week-winners, volume-waking, big-falling, new-listings, shortable-small, unlock-heavy, shorts-paying, talk-rising, cheap-earners.
2. YOUR OWN RULES (`rules`): any mix of market data, Asrai signals and indicators on 4h / 1D / 1W, joined by ~, e.g. 'mc>100000000~ema200_1d=above~asrix_1d=buy@3~copy=0' (= over $100M cap, above the daily 200 EMA, Asrix buy in the last 3 days, no stablecoins). Main fields: mc, vol, ch1h/ch24/ch7/ch30, rank, age, fut (has futures), cat (category slug), funding, asrix_*/at_*/td9_*/sasrix_1d/macd_*/psar_*/ichi_*/ema21_*/ema55_*/ema200_*/rsi_*/smc_*/smcz_*/ew_*/sup_*/res_*. Call with list:'fields' ONCE for the full field list and syntax before writing unusual rules. Your own rules are NOT backtested — say so.
3. CLASSIC LISTS (`screener_type`) — fixed top 10–20 lists (min ~$10M market cap and $1M daily volume unless noted):
TREND FLIPS (fresh signals today, buy + sell lists): macd-coins = MACD just crossed (momentum turning); sar-coins = Parabolic SAR just flipped (trend turning); techrating = TradingView's combined technical rating is Buy/Strong Buy (or Sell) with volume rising.
PULLBACKS & REVERSALS: ichimoku-trend = coins in an uptrend (above cloud and EMA200) pulling back to the cloud top — buy-the-dip candidates (plus a bearish list); bounce-dip = Asrai's bounce list (bouncing off a low) and dip list (dropping into support); rsi = highest RSI (overbought, stretched) and lowest RSI (oversold) on the daily; rsi-heatmap = the same on 4H and 24h, for short-term extremes.
VALUE vs PRICE: vwap = coins trading far below (undervalued) or above (overvalued) their volume-weighted average price.
VOLUME & MONEY: volume = biggest 24h volume increases (something is happening); highvolumelowcap = small caps ($1M–$500M) with volume high vs their market cap — early movers / hidden gems, higher risk.
STRENGTH: stronger-weaker-coins = during a BTC drop, coins that held up (stronger: long candidates for the recovery) and fell more (weaker: short candidates); ath = coins that just made, or are close to, a new all-time high.
SOCIAL: galaxyscore = best combined social + market score (LunarCrush); socialdominance = coins taking the biggest share of social talk.
SUPPLY: late-unlocked-coins = coins whose big token unlocks are mostly done (little selling pressure left).
ASRAI SIGNALS: indicator-today = Asrai indicators (Asrix, TD9…) that fired today; indicator-recent = the last 7 days (fresh_signals filters these by side, timeframe and days).
Tips: when quoting a ready screen, say its backtest mark honestly (a ⚠️ screen is a watch list, not a buy list). For 'what to buy' screen first, then check the best 2–3 coins with coin_brief / trade_plan; for one coin's own signals use technical_analysis. The user's own saved screens: my_screens. Coins of one category or alternatives to a coin: coin_categories.

limit.description: Optional: how many coins to return (1–50, default 20)

list.description: 'ready' = the ready screens; 'fields' = every field + the rule syntax

ready.description: A ready screen key (way 1), e.g. 'fresh-asrix'. No arguments at all = the list of ready screens with their backtest marks.

rules.description: Your own rules (way 2), joined by ~, e.g. 'mc>50000000~rsi_1d<30~fut=1'

screener_type.description: A classic list (way 3). Leave out when using `ready` or `rules`.

sort.description: Optional for ready/rules: field.desc or field.asc, e.g. 'ch24.desc', 'mc.desc'

top.description: Optional: only the biggest N coins by market cap
